keyVerseDR: "I am the way, and the truth, and the life." (Jn 14:6)

level1.title: Jesus Is the Way
level1.story: Jesus said, "Do not be afraid. I am making a home for you in heaven." Thomas asked the way. Jesus said, "I am the Way!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What is Jesus making for us?
How do you follow Jesus' way?
level1.prayer: Jesus, lead me home to heaven. Amen.

activity.title: No troubled hearts
activity.intro: Fill the heart with fingerprints. Jesus says, "Do not be afraid."
activity.label: Jesus is the Way

level2.title: The Way, the Truth, and the Life
level2.story: At the Last Supper, Jesus said, "Do not let your hearts be troubled. In My Father's house there are many rooms." He said He was going to prepare a place for them. Thomas asked, "Lord, how can we know the way?" Jesus answered, "I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me." Philip asked to see the Father, and Jesus said, "Whoever has seen Me has seen the Father."
level2.keyLine: I am the way, and the truth, and the life.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why is Jesus the only way to the Father?
What troubles your heart that you can give to Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, You are my way, truth, and life. Amen.

activity.title: Put Jesus' words in order
activity.intro: Number the word cards to make the verse.
